follow-up time: Median of 26 days from initial positive test to RT-PCR viral clearance
cohort: 67 pregnant patients with confirmed, symptomatic COVID-19
finding: The majority of pregnant women with symptomatic COVID-19 can be managed in the outpatient setting with intensive, protocol-driven monitoring, although 28% required acute care and 13% required hospitalization.
gest_age: Disease progression, time to viral clearance, and duration of symptoms did not vary significantly by trimester of infection
